title: Match browser error expectations
responsibility: Classify observed browser errors and retain expectations that were not observed.

inputs.name: browserErrorRows.diagnostic
inputs.description: One attempt’s observed errors and declared expectations. Each expectation matches exact type and message and, when specified, exact source.

outputs.name: browserErrorRows
outputs.description: Rows in observation order marked Expected or Unexpected, followed by unused expectations marked Missing expected error. Each expectation accounts for one occurrence; matching rows retain diagnostic context and add the expectation reason. Inputs are not modified.
